game.title: Ballpark: The Guessing Game
game.description: Close enough counts. Slide, tap and guess your way through history, the human body and the map.

questions.prompt: Warm-up (everyone scores): in what year was the first Super Bowl played?
In what year did the Titanic sink?
How many keys are on a standard modern piano?
How many bones are in the adult human body?
Roswell, New Mexico — home of the famous 1947 'UFO crash'. Tap where Roswell is.
Everyone scores: where is the geographic center of the contiguous United States? Take a guess.
Which country spans the most time zones (counting overseas territories)?
The little plastic tube on the end of a shoelace is called an ___.
Which of these animals are mammals? Select all that apply.

images.alt_text: Outline map of the United States, with Alaska and Hawaii as insets, showing state borders, with no labels.
